Effect: [When Digivolving] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If a red Tamer card is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent’s Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon instead.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 [Takuya Kanbara] from your hand or trash without paying the cost.
